source_evidence_checks: Actual completed query-migrate results and stopped/postmigrate query-status in QMP logs; completion JSON agrees with the raw logs.

All pre-save geometry/runtime/ROM/core-counter/input/output-Clock observations match independent numerical vectors.
Serialized count/fraction match the fresh projected source value, rather than stale anchor state; all three domains must require freshness.
Actual post-save QOM anchors equal source virtual time and serialized count/fraction.
Raw source QTest logs contain the expected time steps and no per-core counter MMIO reads.
Unknown-profile runtime getters actually fail, while known geometry and input Clock observations corroborate the independently rebuilt cold stream.
destination_evidence_checks: Actual destination QMP migration completes and is observed stopped before cont.
Complete first-restored QOM values and real Clock object periods match loaded stream data with destination epoch 987654321 ns or 73 ns.
Destination state was observably different before incoming.
The first restored observation window contains no cont, system_reset or qom-set.
The first post-cont counter/fraction/core-counter/epoch observations independently preserve the exact one-nanosecond continuation.
Actual QTest time exchanges corroborate both differing origins and all explicit continuation steps.
rejection_evidence: Each rejected attempt must use the actual stream in an incoming QMP request, report exit 1, have the precise profile/field diagnostic and device-specific migration load failure in actual stderr, and have no completed QMP result. The OS exit code is explicitly labelled reported, not independently re-executed.
byte_identity: Verify five stream sizes/hashes, exact unique section positions, complete payloads and saved payload files. Each bad copy differs from the original at exactly one bit in one four-byte field; all other bytes remain identical. Re-read original ZIP members and verify unchanged.
